Independent offline code review, gpt-6-astra xhigh. Read root README and applicable instructions. Root exclusively owns hardware, UART, USB, Windows, network, credentials, recovery; none may be queried or used. Local read-only shell/Python/source/hash/ELF inspection is authorized and expected. No builds, test executions, new agents, code edits. Write ONLY backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/udp-append-observation-review.md. Keep report concrete and <=1600 words.

Review completed frozen candidate backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-udp-append-observation against exact E88 frozen parent and korvo-default-reference-followup/udp-bgn-next-step.md. Another worker may create board-tools/ only; exclude it from pins. Pin selected actual source/artifacts/config/review receipts before substantive review and at end. Candidate sources/build are immutable. Review observational correctness and noninterference, not a benefit claim: IPv4 unicast port59441 selection, every16th nonempty admission, beforewalk/afterwalk/aftercompaction exact3 existinghwclock sites, actuallink and bothmemmove bytecount, noextra traversal, sampling/invalid/saturation logic, RV32atomic shortlock order, NO allocation/newownership/config/algorithm/security/timeout changes. Confirm fixedwidth UDPAPPEND block first and stable even E88 formatter's partialread problem when Root establishes no selectedsocket. Timeincludespreemption/notwholeCPU. Validate actualcompiledinput/config/diff/pair binding, code/staticRAM/stackdelta, focusedhostreceipts and meaning incl actualfunctionon/off IOBequivalence, fixedwidthpartialreads, errors. No need rerun any tests; inspect receipts/inputs. Cite concrete defects/limits if any.

Goal only one Root-owned observational RX30->TX30+quiet60 round, unchanged original E95 workload (1470B nominal40M=41943040bit/s, both-C, board64000, IOB256 reserve24 queue32 BGN PSNONE). No in-load UART polling, no automaticsecondpair, no adoption/performancegain/xTSpass. Kmem residual remainsunresolved. Give narrow GO/NO-GO, measurable instrumentation costs and meaningful stage/resultparser requirements. Broader PS candidate rejected postRX wapi stall is unrelated and must not be used as parent. Do not infer causalrelation or require new broad tests/SDK/instrumentation framework.

I’ll read the repository instructions and frozen evidence, record the selected file hashes, and review the observation code and receipts offline. I’ll write only the requested report, then recheck the hashes.

I’m applying the xTS board evidence skill for firmware pairing and evidence classification. Your stricter offline limits apply: I’ll inspect local files only, with no builds, test executions, device access, or new agents.

The initial pin covers 6,622 selected files, including both builds’ compiled inputs, artifacts, configs, and review receipts; `board-tools/` is excluded. The candidate identifies `korvo-udp-readahead-tail` as its exact E88 parent. I’ll now check the source changes and measurement boundaries.

The changes preserve E88’s append algorithm and ownership sequence. The new counters cover selected read-ahead admissions; direct delivery to a waiting receiver is outside that population. The fixed 494-byte prefix addresses partial-read stability only while Root has established that no selected socket exists; the later legacy lines remain live.

The input hashes match both frozen builds, and the compiled-input comparison finds only the two intended source changes. ELF inspection confirms three clock calls in the linked callback, +1,280 bytes of text, +328 bytes of rodata, and 124 bytes of diagnostic globals absorbed by existing BSS padding. The callback frame grows by 48 bytes; the new formatter adds a separate 240-byte frame. These establish size costs, not runtime overhead.

The saved host receipts support byte and IOB-ownership equivalence between E88 and the observed version, and include partial-read, invalid-clock, saturation, and publication checks. I found a minor provenance inconsistency: `build-receipt.json` names the parent in its `source` field, while its commands and compile database point to the candidate. I’ll document that and make the narrow GO depend on explicit pair binding and strict result parsing.

The report is drafted with a narrow GO for the single observational round and the nonblocking receipt-label defect noted. It includes the measured costs and parser requirements for torn output, sample conservation, invalid clocks, ACKs, and unresolved Kmem retention. I’m checking the final pins now.

Wrote the [1,340-word review](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/udp-append-observation-review.md).

Narrow **GO** with staging/parser requirements. All 6,622 pins unchanged. Kmem remains unresolved; no tests were rerun.
